title: Red-first resolves the base pnpm even after mise prune
body:
Outcome: krn review red-first never reports every run as procedural because the host pruned the base packageManager pnpm version; src/verdict/sandbox.ts pnpmBinary installs the exact declared version on demand (or the review refuses before reserving an attempt with one usage error naming `mise install pnpm@<v>`), so an environment change cannot burn a D10 attempt.
Evidence: PR #162 record 6 (.krn/runs/review-series/a3b6e8ee134180e3cde4ffbf86449ffda82f30460cb4ce45030387e1db29c855/records/6.json): all three judges PASS, every red-first run "cannot resolve base manager pnpm@12.10.1: mise ERROR pnpm@12.10.1 not installed"; a home-directory cleanup session ran `mise prune --yes` at 2026-11-02T06:21:33Z, four minutes before the attempt.
